Case study: a restaurant chain that kept losing new hires

Case study

A global restaurant chain kept losing new hires. Its turnover was well above its competitors'.

McKinsey's people-analytics team was brought in to find out why.

Your guess

Their first guess was pay. What do you think mattered most?

The pilot

The chain ran a pilot built on those findings. Four months in:

  • 100%+100%+rise in customer satisfaction scores
  • 30 sec30 secfaster service
  • 5%5%higher sales
  • ↓Down: new-joiner attrition “decreased substantially”

Source: Arellano, DiLeonardo & Felix, “Using people analytics to drive business performance: A case study” (opens in a new tab), McKinsey Quarterly, July 2017.

Notice the move

The obvious answer wasn't the real root cause. The data pointed somewhere else.

Pay→
  • Career development
  • Store culture
  • Shift length

That's how consultants work: start from the data, not the first guess.
